test_item:
The Cert Provider feature shall verify that the Issuer field of the leaf certificate matches the expected value defined in the configuration.
(issuer name not identical to the configuration; certificate is rejected)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderAndroidInstrumentalTest.apk is installed
3. The test runner is verified with adb shell pm list instrumentation | grep melcocertprovider (if missing run adb install -r -t CertProviderServiceManagerTest.apk)
4. SAM Dongle is inserted into the DUT
5. Configuration files are available under SecurityAssets/oem-certs/cert-provider/{TYPE}/cfgs/
proc:
1. Read the Issuer field of the certificate on the host
$ openssl x509 -in leaf.crt -text
2. Run the OpenSSL chain verification of the certificate on the host
$ openssl verify -verbose -CAfile RootCert.pem -untrusted L1.pem -untrusted L2.pem -untrusted L3.pem SAMcert.pem
3. <DUT-side trigger for wrong-issuer certificate provided by RD (X-e)>
$ <command provided by RD (X-e)>
er:
1. The openssl x509 output shows an "Issuer:" line that is not identical to the issuer name in SecurityAssets/oem-certs/cert-provider/{TYPE}/cfgs/
2. The openssl command prints "SAMcert.pem: OK" on stdout
3. <log keyword provided by RD (X-h)>
